stem.text: Snow melts off a flat roof at a rate of R(t) inches per hour, where R is a positive function and t is measured in hours. Using correct units, interpret the meaning of \( \frac{1}{7}\int_{7}^{14} R(t)\,dt \) in the context of the problem.

answer_key.label: It is the average rate at which snow melts off the roof over the time interval from \( t = 7 \) to \( t = 14 \) hours, measured in inches per hour.

worked_solution.text: R(t) is a rate measured in inches per hour, so integrating it over time multiplies by hours and gives an amount in inches.
worked_solution.rule_named: units of a definite integral of a rate

worked_solution.text: The limits run from \( t = 7 \) to \( t = 14 \) hours, so \( \int_{7}^{14} R(t)\,dt \) is the total depth of snow that melts off the roof from \( t = 7 \) to \( t = 14 \) hours.
worked_solution.rule_named: integral of a rate is the accumulated change

worked_solution.text: Dividing by the length of the interval, 7 hours, turns the amount into an average rate, so the expression is the average rate at which snow melts off the roof from \( t = 7 \) to \( t = 14 \) hours, in inches per hour.
